Class SHAFT.Infrastructure

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.driver.SHAFT.Infrastructure
Enclosing class:
SHAFT
public static final class SHAFT.Infrastructure extends Object
Plans, diagnoses, verifies, and explicitly provisions SHAFT-owned local infrastructure. Read-only methods use Properties.infrastructure; mutation always requires an exact SetupApproval for the supplied plan.
